newsitem.title: USA: Lucent Sept qtr revs, pro forma net rises.
newsitem.headline: Lucent Sept qtr revs, pro forma net rises.

text.p: The historical financial information presented for calendar 1995 reflects the results of operations of the businesses transferred to Lucent Technologies from AT&T. The consolidated financial statements have been prepared from the financial statements of AT&T using the historical results of operations and historical basis of the assets and liabilities of these businesses. Additionally, the consolidated financial statements for calendar 1995 of Lucent include the allocation of certain assets, liabilities, revenues and expenses which were not historically recorded at the level of, but are primarily related to, Lucent's businesses. Management believes the allocations underlying Lucent's historical financial statements to be reasonable.

The pro forma net income (loss) per share for all periods was calculated by dividing the net income (loss) by the 636,661,931 shares that were outstanding subsequent to the Initial Public Offering of 112,037,037 shares in April 1996 and gives no effect to the use of proceeds from the Initial Public Offering.
c) Business Restructuring and Other Charges

The pre-tax charge in the quarter ending December 31, 1995 for restructuring, impairments and other charges of $2,801 million was recorded as $892 million of costs, $1,645 million of selling, general and administrative expenses, and $264 million of research and development expenses. The charges include $1,509 million for employee separations; $627 million for asset write- downs; $202 million for closing, selling and consolidating facilities; and $463 million for other items. The total charges reduced net income by $1,847 million.
